raw.query: SELECT variate, resolution, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters')) AS best_baseline_wape, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('chronos', 'timesfm', 'toto')) AS best_fm_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics GROUP BY variate, resolution HAVING MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters')) < MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('chronos', 'timesfm', 'toto')) ORDER BY variate, resolution;
raw.observed: EWMA baseline outperforms all foundation models in 2 cells: ctx/1min (ewma 0.3827355809461447 vs best FM toto 0.38482784156650457) and images/1min (ewma 0.47926549309674765 vs best FM timesfm 0.4826379762334363) when evaluating individual forecast horizons in forecast_metrics. Under the restricted point-forecast aggregate over horizons (h = -1, span = 'common', candidate = 'point'), foundation models win in all 20 cells.
raw.claimed: the foundation models beat every baseline in all twenty cells
raw.evidence: EWMA baseline achieves a lower WAPE than the best foundation model in the ctx/1min and images/1min cells at shorter horizons.
